summary: Validated the new SA Coparents IPV Communication Safety Assessment end-to-end. Backend: 16/16 pytest pass in /app/backend/tests/test_safety_assessment.py covering pure score_assessment() (all 4 levels including 5 high-concern triggers, 2+ coercive=L2, 1 mild yes=L3, 3+ readiness concerns=L3, all-no=L4), GET /questions (10 S1 + 8 S2 + correct high_concern_ids), POST /api/safety-assessment as guest with L1/L2/L4 scoring, GET /me=latest, GET /{id}/pdf (returns %PDF + correct content-type), POST /{id}/email rejects guests with 400 'Save your work…' and proceeds (non-guest-reject) for a real registered user. Worksheet save+list also passes. Frontend: /safety shows both new CTAs (safety-take-assessment-cta + safety-open-worksheet-cta). /safety-assessment intro auto-bootstraps a guest session, Start button advances to Section 1, the 10 Yes/No/Unsure groups render, clicking Yes on s1_q1 immediately raises the high-concern-overlay with 911 / 800-799-7233 / text START to 88788 / Quick Exit / Change my answer / Continue the assessment all visible. Clicking 'Change my answer' clears the Yes and closes the overlay. Completing all 18 questions (all No on S1, all Yes on S2 q1-7, No on q8) lands on assessment-results showing 'LEVEL 4 PATHWAY · Cooperative Co-Parenting Communication', recommendations bullets, Texas Resources block, Download/Email/Worksheet buttons. As a guest, 'Email me a copy' surfaces the 'Save my work' toast (verified 400 from POST /{id}/email and toast text). /problem-solving renders the 9-prompt form (11 input/textarea fields), Save Worksheet shows worksheet-saved-banner and the TEST_handover_issue row appears under Recent worksheets.

issues: Results card shows 'LEVEL 4 PATHWAY' in the header but does not repeat the numeric Level in the body — minor; the pathway title is clear so this is acceptable. Just noting that the inner_text didn't match a generic 'Level' substring during automated verification because the L is part of an uppercase header chip.

critical_code_review_comments: score_assessment() is a pure function and is now unit-tested directly — good. One subtle behavior to confirm with product: a single non-high-concern yes (e.g. s1_q7) currently yields Level 3, but a single yes on s1_q3 alone also yields Level 3 even though s1_q3 is a coercive-control flag. With 2+ coercive flags it correctly escalates to Level 2. If product wants any single coercive flag to be Level 2, the threshold needs to drop from 2 to 1.

POST /api/safety-assessment/{id}/email returns 400 with detail 'Save your work to email yourself a copy.' for guests, but the frontend toast shows the text directly. If a localized copy is added later, the backend detail string and the frontend toast should be kept in sync (or the frontend should use the response detail).

HighConcernOverlay flashedRef: after clicking 'Change my answer' and then Yes again, the overlay does re-show. The agent-to-agent note said 'toggling yes->no->yes won't re-trigger', which is true for plain Yes/No toggling, but 'Change my answer' explicitly resets state and re-flashes. This is arguably desired UX (user deliberately retracted, so re-warn) — just confirm it's intentional.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — Safety CTAs, intro, S1 questions, high-concern overlay UX (yes->overlay->change-my-answer->yes-cleared), full 18-question flow to L4 results, guest email toast, and worksheet save+banner+recent-list all verified

test_credentials: parent1@test.com / TestPass123! intact; new transient TEST_sa_<hex>@test.com user created per session for the email-non-guest test (auto-expires).
seed_data_creation: Each test run inserts one safety_assessments doc per submit + one problem_solving_worksheets doc; prefixed with TEST_ where applicable. No manual cleanup required.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file: /app/backend/tests/test_safety_assessment.py — note it explicitly loads /app/backend/.env at import time so JWT_SECRET/MONGO_URL are present before importing safety_assessment_routes. The legal acknowledgment modal must be dismissed via localStorage seed: localStorage.setItem('sac_legal_ack_v1', JSON.stringify({version:'v1', at: new Date().toISOString()})) — setting it to the string 'true' is NOT enough (component JSON.parses it). Orientation gate: localStorage.setItem('sacoparents.orientation_seen.v1','true'). High-concern overlay is at [data-testid=high-concern-overlay], buttons are plain '<button>Change my answer</button>' and '<button>Continue the assessment</button>'. Results page testid: 'assessment-results'. Worksheet save/banner testids: 'worksheet-save-button' / 'worksheet-saved-banner'. Email-as-guest correctly hits POST /api/safety-assessment/{id}/email → 400 → frontend surfaces toast with 'Save my work' action.
rca of the issue: N/A — feature addition, no bug. Implementation matches spec on all 14 requested test points.
